Crafted from high-quality materials and engineered for efficiency, this is a premium-grade dehumidifier built to perform wherever you need it most — from protecting your home to maintaining dry, comfortable conditions in caravans, workshops, and storage spaces.

One E25 thermostat can control multiple smart radiator valves within the same room, making this kit suitable for rooms with more than one radiator. Important smart functionality notice:This kit does not include an ENGO gateway. The thermostat and smart radiator valve can be paired locally for basic heating control. However, smart features such as app control, heating schedules, timers, and remote access require an ENGO gateway, which must be purchased separately. The thermostat itself is not programmable. It allows manual temperature adjustment only. All scheduling and automation are handled through the ENGO app when a gateway is added. This kit is designed specifically for ENGO smart heating systems and is not compatible with other brands or generic Zigbee hubs. It is ideal for customers who already own an ENGO gateway or who want to add app control later.

These pegs are typically made of durable materials like plastic or metal and are specifically engineered for outdoor use. They have barbs or ridges along their length to provide extra grip and stability when inserted into the soil. The pegs are usually around 6 to 8 inches long, providing adequate anchoring for the pipes. Uses: Securing Irrigation Components: The primary use of these barbed hold down pegs is to secure 1/2" irrigation pipes, including water supply pipes, seep hoses, and drip lines, in a garden or landscape. They help prevent the pipes from moving, shifting, or being exposed, ensuring that the irrigation system functions efficiently. Keeping the Garden Neat and Tidy: These pegs are essential for maintaining a clean and organized garden. By keeping the irrigation pipes secured to the ground, they prevent tripping hazards and unsightly tangles of hoses, contributing to a neater and more aesthetically pleasing garden. Preventing Damage: In windy conditions or high-traffic areas, unsecured irrigation pipes may become dislodged or damaged. Barbed hold down pegs provide a reliable way to keep the pipes in place and prevent them from being accidentally stepped on or damaged by garden equipment. product.name: Invena 1/2 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose. product.name: Invena 3/4 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose.    Specifications:       Material: nickel plated brass; ball made from steel;   3/4 inch bsp female x female thread   Equipped with additional drain valve   Max working temperature: 120c   Max working pressure: 1,6 mpa

product.name: Hoses UK 40mm Clear PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 8m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a lightweight, UV-resistant and flexible hose designed for water transfer, pond circulation, and general fluid handling. Its transparent design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it ideal for applications that benefit from visual inspection. Manufactured with a smooth PVC inner wall and a corrugated PVC outer layer, the hose incorporates a high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear corrugated PVC hose is designed for medium-duty environments requiring a crush-resistant, UV-stable, and easy-to-handle flexible hose. Operating from -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C) and compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this corrugated PVC hose provides reliability, resilience, and ease of use in a variety of light to medium-duty environments. Key features include a smooth bore for consistent water or fluid flow, a flexible corrugated exterior for efficient fluid transfer, and a tough plastic rib reinforcement that resists crushing and maintains flow integrity under mechanical stress. The transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, which is particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. This hose is also widely used for workshop water transfer and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential. Available in a range of sizes with internal diameters from 19 mm to 50 mm and wall thicknesses from 2 mm to 4 mm, the Hoses UK Clear PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is suitable for a variety of applications including pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, and light industrial fluid handling tasks.

product.name: Clear Garden Hose 6m 13mm (1/2") Bore Braided Reinforced PVC Water Stop Quick Connectors Both Ends Rainwater Butt Pump Watering
product.description:
A 6 metre made-up length of 13mm (1/2 inch) bore clear PVC braided hose with a female water stop connector fitted at each end, supplied ready to use.

BRAIDED REINFORCEMENT. A polyester braid is set into the wall, so the hose handles more pressure than plain unreinforced tube, resists kinking on tight bends and is far less prone to collapsing when used on the suction side of a pump. It stays flexible enough to coil for storage.

WATER STOP CONNECTORS. Both ends take a standard push-fit garden hose connector. The water stop valve closes automatically when a fitting is released, so the hose holds its water instead of emptying over your feet and accessories can be swapped mid-job without going back to the tap.

TYPICAL USES. Water butt and pond pump transfer, filling and emptying containers, caravan, motorhome and boat water filling, siphoning and draining, brewing and aquarium work, compressor and workshop air or fluid lines, plus general garden jobs where seeing the flow is an advantage.

SPECIFICATION. Bore 13mm (1/2 inch). Length 6 metres. Clear PVC with polyester braid reinforcement. Female water stop connector at both ends. Not suitable for drinking water and not intended for hot water or pressurised mains plumbing.

product.name: Polypropylene Camlock lay flat hose fittings/connectors /adaptors( TYPE C ) for 1" hose
product.description: Camlock layflat hose fittings are a popular choice for various fluid transfer applications, known for their efficiency and reliability. These fittings are specifically designed for use with layflat hoses, which are flexible and lightweight hoses that can be easily rolled up for storage and transportation. Camlock fittings consist of male and female connectors that securely lock together, ensuring a tight and leak-free connection. The design features a cam and groove mechanism, where the male adapter with a protruding cam is inserted into the female coupling with a groove, and then rotated to create a secure connection. This mechanism allows for quick and effortless connections without the need for additional tools or clamps. The fittings are typically made from durable materials such as aluminum, stainless steel, or brass, providing strength and resistance to corrosion. The choice of material depends on the specific application requirements and the compatibility with the fluids being transferred. Camlock layflat hose fittings come in various sizes and configurations to accommodate different hose diameters and connection types. They are available in a wide range of styles, including Type A, B, C, D, E, F, and DC, each with its unique features and compatibility. These fittings are commonly used in industries such as agriculture, construction, mining, and firefighting, where the efficient transfer of liquids or gases is essential. They are favored for their ease of use, reliability, and versatility, allowing for quick setup and disassembly of hoses in various applications. Overall, camlock layflat hose fittings provide a convenient and efficient solution for connecting and disconnecting layflat hoses, ensuring a secure and leak-free transfer of fluids in a wide range of industries and applications

product.name: 2"  camlock cam & groove layflat hose fittings type A, female bsp thread pump connector
product.description:
Camlock Type A fittings are a type of quick-connect coupling commonly used in fluid transfer systems. These fittings consist of a male adaptor with a male thread on one end and a camlock (grooved) connection on the other. The male thread allows the fitting to be connected to a female-threaded pipe or hose, while the camlock connection is designed to quickly and securely connect to a female camlock coupler (Types B, C, D, or DC).

Material: Camlock Type A fittings are typically made from a variety of materials, including aluminum, stainless steel, brass, and polypropylene, depending on the application requirements.

Sizes: These fittings are available in a range of sizes, typically from ½ inch to 6 inches, to accommodate different hose and pipe diameters.

Design Features:

Male Adaptor: One end has a male threaded adaptor, which can be screwed into a female-threaded component.
Grooved End: The opposite end features the camlock design, which includes a groove that allows the female camlock coupler to latch securely onto it using cam arms.
Uses of Camlock Type A Fittings:
Camlock Type A fittings are used in a wide range of industries due to their versatility and ease of use. Here are some common applications:

Fluid Transfer Systems:

Used in the transfer of liquids, including water, chemicals, petroleum products, and fuels, from one container or pipe to another.
Agriculture:

Employed in irrigation systems, pesticide spraying, and transferring liquid fertilizers.
Chemical Processing:

Utilized in industries where chemicals are transferred between tanks, pipes, and machinery.
Food and Beverage Industry:

Used in sanitary applications for transferring liquids like juices, milk, and other food-grade substances, especially when made from stainless steel or other sanitary materials.
Petroleum Industry:

Essential in the transfer of fuels and other petroleum-based liquids, where a secure, leak-proof connection is crucial.

product.name: 5mm 3 Metre PVC Clear Plastic Flexible Hose Pipe With FREE Stainless Steel Clips
product.description:
This Unreinforced PVC Hose represents a flexible and economical choice for low-pressure fluid and air transfer. Fabricated from high-grade soft polyvinyl chloride (PVC), it combines lightweight maneuverability with high transparency, making it easy to visually monitor flow in water, air, and mild chemical applications. With a comprehensive size range from 3mm to 25mm internal diameter, this tubing is adaptable to a wide variety of domestic, laboratory, and industrial requirements.

Designed for efficiency, the hose features a smooth bore and consistent wall thickness to ensure reliable flow rates, while its unreinforced nature ensures it remains lightweight and easy to install. It performs consistently in temperatures ranging from -10°C to +65°C, capable of withstanding short-term peaks up to +70°C. The hose offers excellent pliability, supporting bend radii between 20mm and 180mm depending on the bore size. With a working pressure rating of 1.5 Bar and a burst limit of 4.5 Bar, it is robust enough for most general-purpose tasks. Whether used for garden irrigation, PC water cooling loops, or workshop air routing, this clear hose offers a durable, clean, and practical solution.

product.name: 40mm Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This Black Plastic Inline Barbed Hose Joiner is the perfect solution for connecting two hoses securely and efficiently. Made from durable, chemical-resistant polypropylene, this joiner is built to handle air, water, coolant, and other low-pressure fluid transfer systems. The double barbed ends provide a tight, leak-resistant grip without the need for additional clips in many cases, though clamps can be used for added security. Its lightweight, corrosion-resistant design ensures longevity even in harsh environments, making it suitable for automotive, marine, industrial, and domestic use. Available in a wide range of internal diameter sizes from 6mm to 102mm, it offers a versatile fit for various hose types including silicone, PVC, and rubber. Whether you're making repairs, extending hose runs, or building custom systems, this reliable joiner provides a secure connection with minimal fuss. Quick to install and easy to use, it delivers a strong hold and smooth internal bore to maintain consistent flow across your application. product.name: Layflat Discharge Hose Pipe Yellow 32mm ID PVC Polyester Reinforced Submersible Pump Compatible, 20m and 2 Hose Clips
product.description: This bundle combines Hoses UK PVC Layflat Hose with two W4 stainless steel worm drive hose clips, providing a ready-to-use water transfer solution with everything needed to make secure, leak-free connections straight out of the box. The layflat hose features a smooth PVC inner bore reinforced with high-strength polyester yarn, delivering reliable performance at a working pressure of 4 bar across agricultural, construction and industrial pumping applications. Manufactured to ISO 8029:2007, it operates between -10°C and +65°C and lies flat when empty for compact storage and easy deployment. The two included stainless steel worm drive hose clips (DIN 3017, W4 grade, 12 mm band) clamp securely onto the hose ends, ensuring a firm seal on pipes, fittings and spigots. With a 3:1 safety factor and an operating temperature of -60°C to +180°C, the clips are built to last in demanding environments without the need for additional fasteners.

product.description: This high-performance 180-degree silicone elbow is expertly engineered for demanding applications requiring tight-radius bends and reliable flow. Wall thickness remains consistent at 4.5–5.5mm across sizes, supporting working pressures from 2.8 to 12.33 Bar and burst pressures up to 37 Bar. The 100mm leg length and tight bend radius make it perfect for compact installations. Available in a wide range of diameters (6.5mm–102mm), this elbow is ideal for both performance upgrades and OEM replacements where precision and quality are critical.
